services.desc: A Hot Air balloon is a fantastic way to have a wedding ceremony. This page will provide some helpful information and guidance about your special experience. We have a few pilots that are Florida Notaries and a photographer who is a clergy. In Florida, a Notary can perform your wedding ceremony (click here for details.) We specialize in making sure your "I Do" happens on schedule. All of our Romantic Packages are designed as static displays, which means we can almost always proceed even if the upper winds aren't cooperating for a traditional flight.
